_not_minted_deliberately.banner: The prototype's amber banner (L171, 'มีการเปลี่ยนอะไหล่ — ระบบจะสร้างใบเสนอราคาส่งลูกค้าผ่าน LINE OA อัตโนมัติ') is DROPPED, not keyed. It promises an automation that does not exist: nothing auto-raises a pmQuote (POST /pm/quotes is a manual route, apps/api/src/routes/pm.ts L830) and LINE is a verified no-op stub (lineNotifyStub L218-220, B-108b). A missing VALUE can be em-dashed; a false PROMISE cannot. Minting a key for it would leave the screen one edit away from making the claim again — so the sidecar test asserts that no sidecar slot RESOLVES to text containing 'LINE OA' or 'ใบเสนอราคา'. See BLOCKERS.md B-281.
_not_minted_deliberately.ctaLabel: The prototype's CTA label (L175, 'ไปสรุป + ปิดงาน') is DROPPED for the same reason, and was REMOVED from this mint in review round 2 (it was staged in round 1). In the prototype that button is a pure NAVIGATION — onClick={() => setScreen('pm-close')} — and performs no save. pm-close is not built here, and this port's button performs the SAVE the prototype never had and stays on the screen, so the label would promise BOTH a destination the app does not have AND an action the button does not perform. The sidecar test forbids any slot resolving to text containing 'ปิดงาน' or 'ไปสรุป', including via an existing dict id. What ships instead: common.save before a durable save, pm.btnNext (honest-DISABLED) after one. This is NOT the only deviation from tests/visual/reference/mobile/pm-notes.png in the slice — that image also renders the amber banner as a full orange-bordered section (dropped here, see .banner), the parts row as 'Safety Edge Sensor MX-SE12' / '1 ชุด · 3,200 ฿' (em-dashed here, see .partsValue), and the three note boxes as the static mock sentences (editable inputs over the real cause/fix/advice columns here). BLOCKERS.md B-285 enumerates that whole set and files THIS label for a ruling — if Wei rules fidelity wins there, restore this entry to the mint, noting that restoring the label alone still does not make the screen match the reference image.
_not_minted_deliberately.partsValue: 'Safety Edge Sensor MX-SE12' / '1 ชุด · 3,200 ฿' (L166) are mock DATA, not keys — and money. pm_workorder has no parts column (parts live on pmQuotes.parts), so the kept label renders over an em-dash.
_not_minted_deliberately.woNumber: 'PMWO-2569-0312' (L151 eyebrow) is mock data, not a key. pm_workorder stores no document number and workOrderWire exposes none, so the eyebrow em-dashes (the pm_jobs agg omits the same field for the same reason).
